meta.title: SwtFrontend — Your Retro Games, Beautifully Organized
meta.description: Turn your Android into a stunning retro game console. Play NES, SNES, Genesis, DS and more with beautiful cover art, achievements, and a Switch-inspired design. Free and open-source.
hero.headline: Your Retro Games, Beautifully Organized
hero.sub: Turn your Android phone or tablet into the ultimate retro gaming console. Gorgeous covers, smooth performance, and a design inspired by the Nintendo Switch.
features.title: A Console Experience on Your Phone
features.subtitle: Everything a retro gamer wants, nothing they don't.
features.grid.0.title: Modern Console Look
features.grid.0.desc: A sleek interface inspired by the Nintendo Switch. Choose from 12 beautiful accent colors and switch between light and dark modes.
features.grid.1.title: Play Instantly
features.grid.1.desc: No complicated setup. No BIOS files needed. Just drop in your games and start playing right away.
features.grid.2.title: Beautiful Cover Art
features.grid.2.desc: Game covers are fetched automatically. Your library looks stunning without any manual work.
features.grid.3.title: Smart Library
features.grid.3.desc: Your games organize themselves — recent picks, collections, and instant search. Find anything in seconds.
features.grid.4.title: Play Your Way
features.grid.4.desc: Touch controls, Bluetooth gamepad, or connect to your TV. Play however feels best.
features.grid.5.title: Never Lose Progress
features.grid.5.desc: Your game saves are automatic. Pick up exactly where you left off, every time.
features.grid.6.title: Dual Screen Mode
features.grid.6.desc: Nintendo DS games look amazing with the second screen on another display. Just like the real thing.
features.grid.7.title: Achievements & Trophies
features.grid.7.desc: Earn achievements and compete with friends through RetroAchievements. Optional hardcore mode for the brave.
features.grid.8.title: Manage from Your PC
features.grid.8.desc: A built-in dashboard lets you manage your library from any web browser on your computer. No cables needed.
features.grid.9.title: Games & Apps Together
features.grid.9.desc: Your games and Android apps live side by side. Plus, it's completely free and open source.
how.title: Start Playing in Minutes
how.subtitle: Getting started is incredibly easy.
how.step.1.title: Copy Your Games
how.step.1.desc: Transfer your ROM files to your phone using any file manager or USB cable.
how.step.2.title: Open SwtFrontend
how.step.2.desc: Launch the app and point it to your game folder. It finds everything automatically.
how.step.3.title: Play!
how.step.3.desc: Your library is ready. Tap any game and start playing instantly.
faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know.
faq.q1.a: Yes! SwtFrontend is completely free with no ads, no subscriptions, and no hidden costs. It's open source under the GPLv3 license.
faq.q2.a: No! Unlike some other emulators, SwtFrontend doesn't require any BIOS files. Just add your games and play.
faq.q3.q: Where do I put my ROMs?
faq.q3.a: Anywhere on your phone! You can use internal storage, SD card, or any folder. The app uses Android's file picker to let you choose.
faq.q4.q: Will it work on my phone or TV?
faq.q4.a: SwtFrontend works on Android phones, tablets, and TV boxes running Android 7.0 or newer. You can connect to your TV via HDMI or screen mirroring.
faq.q5.a: Yes! Any Bluetooth gamepad that works with Android is supported. You can also use on-screen touch controls if you prefer.
faq.q6.a: SwtFrontend has built-in RetroAchievements support. Earn trophies and compete with friends — just like on modern consoles!
footer.disclaimer: SwtFrontend is a game launcher. It does not include any games. You must own the games you play. RetroAchievements is a trademark of RetroAchievements.org.
